messages:
elena: Quick heads-up for tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. We'll do a canary for routing-weight-safeguard. Plan: open flag to 0.3% for 10m (smoke), then 3% for 20m, then 12% if stable. Pin model to v3.2-stable for canary. @rory @jun please ack and own monitoring. :hourglass:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: routing-weight-safeguard @ 23:00 UTC. Auto-ramp: 0.3% -> 3% (10m soak) -> 12% (conditional). Health pings every 20s. Auto-hold on 3 failed pings or errorRate > 0.6%.

rory: ack. I'll watch latency dashboards. Suggested rollback thresholds: errorRate > 0.6% sustained 3m OR p95 increase > +220ms over baseline -> rollback. Also add policy: if p99 jumps > +400ms once, hold and manual-check.

jun: I'll add a smoke test script to run after each ramp step (5 short requests). Also recommend cohort-drain=30s on rollback.

ops-anne: Pre-warm caches on canary nodes for 6m. Tag deploy meta: change_window=quiet-evening, owner=elena. On rollback, run cache warm on stable nodes before opening traffic.

elena: CLI runbook command for runbook notes:
```
infra flag toggle routing-weight-safeguard --cohort 0.003 --stage smoke --pin model=v3.2-stable --meta "deploy:6400000001;window:quiet-evening"
```

rory: I'll be primary oncall for the window. jun backup. I'll flip the flag off immediately if gates trip and post status here.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6400000025. Health pings live to #eng-releases-canary (20s).

elena: first 6m prelim metrics: errorRate 0.05%, p95 +70ms, p99 +120ms. proceeding toward 3% stage unless objections.

jun: smoke tests passed after smoke stage. ready to ramp in 3m.

rory: watching graphs. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback and pin traffic to stable route. Keeping this thread for postflight notes.
